full_judgment:
By this application under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure whereupon a Rule was issued calling upon the opposite party No.1 to show cause as to why the judgment and decree dated 14- 5-2005 passed by the learned Additional District Judge in Paribarik Appeal No. 32 of 2005 reversing the judgment and order dated 9-3-2005 passed by the learned 5th Assistant Judge and Family Court Judge, Dhaka in Family Case No. 400 of 2005 should not be set aside and or pass such other order or orders as may seem fit and proper. 

 8. The plaintiff-opposite party being aggrieved by aforesaid decision sought for setting aside the same through appeal before the learned District Judge, Dhaka. The learned appellate Court reversed the order of the Family Court and decreed the suit. Hence this revision.
